config._comment_user: Least-privileged replication user from source/postgres/init.sql (REPLICATION + SELECT); not a superuser
config._comment_password: Resolved by the Connect worker from the mounted secret file (DirectoryConfigProvider); never stored in the config
config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.publication.name: cdc_publication
config.slot.name: debezium_slot
config._comment_include: Same filter as the Simulated project: every ecommerce table except pipeline/infra tables
config._comment_identity: REPLICA IDENTITY is set in source/postgres/init.sql by the table owner: FULL for state tables, DEFAULT for append-only ones
config._comment_converters: Plain JSON without embedded schemas: the Spark landing job stores the envelope as a string and Flink reads it with format debezium-json. The Simulated project uses the Schema Registry instead (5-byte header), which neither consumer here expects
config._comment_pii: Personal data is hashed (salted SHA-256) before it leaves PostgreSQL. The salt is read from secrets/pii_salt and substituted for ${PII_SALT} by debezium/register.sh
config._comment_outbox: Outbox rows become domain events on events.<aggregatetype>; other tables pass through untouched
config._comment_tombstones: No tombstones: nothing is log-compacted, and deletes already carry the full old row in before
config.heartbeat.action.query: INSERT INTO ecommerce.cdc_heartbeat (id,ts) VALUES (1,NOW()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET ts = NOW()
config._comment_errors: Fail fast: a change that cannot be converted stops the task instead of being dropped
